experiment_template.research_question: Do construction checkpoints improve GLM repairs within 24 calls at 12K?
stop_conditions: 24 model attempts, 48 tokenizer attempts; zero retries; 1800 seconds per episode.
Infrastructure, source integrity or cleanup failure pauses unstarted dispatches.
USD 0.10 model reserve per episode, USD 0.80 total.

success_criteria.correctness: Full private repair/regression scores; passing patches reproduced.
success_criteria.coverage: 8 terminal episodes, four paired comparisons; retain failures.
success_criteria.integrity: Identical initial prompts, common transport/scoring; only construction checkpoint tools and phase text differ.
success_criteria.screen: More paired wins than losses, zero new false rejections, at most 20 percent mean token and elapsed increase.

records.falsifier: No repair gain or unacceptable cost.
records.mechanism: Earlier staging preserves opportunities for testing and revision.
records.scope: Two observed Svelte tasks, GLM at 12K, two repetitions; development pilot only.
records.statement: Construction checkpoints improve full repair completion under the fixed GLM budget.

records.claim: Construction checkpoints did not satisfy the joint pilot repair/cost screen; retain counterevidence and investigate separately.
limitations: Two observed tasks, same repository and model; two repetitions per task.

records.next_action: Close this GLM small-window round with scoped evidence; select any later intervention or generalization as a separate plan.

records.claim: Three checkpoint-exposed episodes produced no accepted candidate. Two received exact-text recovery advice requiring a source reread while the checkpoint withheld read tools. This is counterevidence for this strict scheduling policy; it does not establish that all recovery reservation is ineffective. The reserved arm's submitted patch was staged before exposure.
limitations: Output truncation and weak inability reports remain separate failure mechanisms.
Post-run descriptive interpretation, not a separately randomized mediator comparison.
Two observed tasks and two repetitions; no broad model qualification.

records.next_action: Do not adopt strict checkpoints. Any next experiment must preserve error-specific recovery actions, distinguish schema repair from task repair, and use a separately frozen comparison.
